stdout:
inbox  [stage]
  Triage a raw inbox entry into a work item.

request  [stage]
  Capture what is being asked for, and why.
  produces: initial-request.md

spec  [stage]
  Decide what to build and why, before deciding how.
  inputs:   initial-request.md, intake.md
  produces: spec.md
  bind:    skill:superpowers:brainstorming

plan  [stage]
  Decide how to build it, in ordered, checkable steps.
  inputs:   initial-request.md, intake.md, spec.md
  produces: plan.md

implement  [stage]
  Build it, and record what actually happened.
  inputs:   spec.md, plan.md, rework.md
  produces: outcome.md

verify  [stage]
  Obtain the user's acceptance decision on the finished work.
  inputs:   spec.md, outcome.md
  produces: refined-outcome.md (accepted) or rework.md (rejected)

postmortem  [stage]
  Find which stage first missed a problem. Out-of-band: legal in review or after completion, and never changes status.
  inputs:   initial-request.md, intake.md, spec.md, plan.md, outcome.md, refined-outcome.md, rework.md
  produces: post-mortem.md

start  [transition]
  Begin implementation.
  moves:    backlog → active
  gates:    unresolved blockers; the initiative epic must be active

submit  [transition]
  Hand finished work to verification.
  moves:    active → review

rework  [transition]
  Send rejected work back for another pass.
  moves:    review → active
  gates:    refined-outcome.md must be absent

complete  [transition]
  Close the item as shipped.
  moves:    review | active → completed
  gates:    unresolved blockers; open initiative children; declared capabilities reconciled; worktree merge-back; --confirm

discard  [transition]
  Close the item without shipping. Reached as `complete --resolution <not-done>`, not a verb of its own.
  moves:    backlog | active | review → discarded
  gates:    --confirm

auto-delete  [transition]
  Remove a resolved item from the store, after it has been committed where it landed. Reached as part of a resolving transition under `work.retain: <status>: false`, not as a verb of its own; `tcw work delete` finishes one a failed `pre` binding left pending.
  moves:    completed | discarded → (removed)
  gates:    work.retain must say the status is not kept
